title: Bloodbath
paragraphs: “Actually, from my perspective, this feels like a story on the verge of being canceled that suddenly hit its climax. It starts with a sudden revelation, and the plot twists are coming so fast I can’t keep up.”
After muttering that, Father let out a deep sigh.
“That’s way too meta… This isn’t even a game or an anime to begin with.”
“My memory’s a bit fuzzy in some places—maybe it’s because of the loop this time. Still, I don’t recall fighting anything and losing.”
“I’m not so sure about that… As for the rest, given the parallel branching worlds, it could be a parallel world… or maybe it’s simply a world like a replay or the remnants of the past.”
Father is clicking his tongue in exasperation. I don’t quite understand this “replay” business, but I can imagine what you mean by “remnants of the past.”
“If that’s the case, we’re at a loss. Not only can’t I see a way to solve this, but there’s even the possibility that everything in this world is a lie.”
Either way, I’ll follow Father’s orders and forge a path toward the future. That’s right… onto the road to true peace, walking alongside Filo-tan!
“Just try getting stuck in a bad state. It would be utterly miserable. After all, it’s something only those caught in the loop can perceive.”
“That’s a grim thought.”
“Still… that’s no reason to give up on everything right here.”
At that moment, Father looked at me with a distant expression in his eyes. I’ve seen that look before. It’s the same look Father, Ren, and Itsuki occasionally gave me during the previous loop.
“Why does that role have to fall to Motoyasu?”
“No matter what happens, I’m on your side, Father.”
“What are you talking about? You were the one who suddenly started accusing me!”
“That was me from way back in the past. I’m different now!”
“You just caused trouble again! Ugh, this is such a hassle! If you can’t come up with an answer, let’s put it off for now.”
“So, what should we do, then?”

“…There is a way to test whether world fusion will occur by letting the ‘limit of the waves’ be reached… but that’s essentially the same as destroying the world. I can’t very well try that… I suppose. For now, I guess I’ll just have to calm the waves down whenever they occur.”
As expected of Father! I certainly think that’s the safest course of action.
“So, Motoyasu. What exactly is your goal?”
That again? No matter how many times you ask, my answer will always be the same.
“To bring peace to the world and live happily with Filo-chan!”
“Guh!?”
“Motoyasu, what on earth is it about this bird that you’re so obsessed with?　I just can’t wrap my head around it at all…”
“Hahaha! You’re quite the joker, Father. Filo-tan will soon grow into an angel and start speaking clearly.”
“…Well, we’ll verify whether that’s true later. For now, let’s face reality.”

But I’m always facing reality, aren’t I? Oh? Father in my memory is saying, ‘You’re just dreaming, aren’t you?’ That’s not true. I’m looking at reality—I’m looking at Filo-chan! Glance, glance, glance, glance… Stare! Just as I was casting glances at Filo-chan like that, Father took charge of the situation again.

“Since I killed that woman, there’s no way I can operate in Melromarc anymore. But then again, how am I supposed to escape from here…? Well, with Motoyasu’s trump card, I suppose I could physically escape anywhere…”
“That’s easy, Father. I’d like you to let me join your party.”
“…I really don’t want to, but…”
Father invited me to join the party, though he seemed reluctant. After that, I just need to use my Portal skill to go wherever I want.
“So, Father, is there a country you’d like to go to?”
“I don’t know much about this world.”

“Well then… if I recall correctly from what you said, Father, I’ll teleport us to the village where you were staying around this time of year. It’s not that far, and we can just go back for the wagon later.”
“Huh?”
“Portal Spear!”
Raising my spear, I cast the teleportation skill. Of course, I designated Father and the others as the targets. In an instant, we arrived at Riyute Village.
“Gwa!?”

The scenery changed in the blink of an eye, and everyone—including Filo-chan and Father—looked utterly stunned. It seems the portal’s location is fixed this time. Since I’ve invested skill points in it, it remembers quite a few locations.
“W-What is this!?”
“So you have a teleportation skill…”
“There’s a cooldown before I can use it again, but I can get to other countries in an instant!”
“I see… Well then, I can make a quick getaway in a flash.”
That’s exactly the kind of thing Father from the first world would say. I’ll make a quick getaway and be done with all this trouble.
“Before that, we’ll need to retrieve the cart… and help with the reconstruction, I suppose? We’ll need to procure some lumber.”

“Y-yeah, you’re right. Since I realize I can’t really help much with the reconstruction, I’ll donate the money I got from Motoyasu. I don’t really want to stay in populated areas—you never know when I might get caught.”
“Well then, let’s get the operation started!”
Things are about to get busy!
“Um… you’re just taking the Spear Hero as an ally as if it’s the most natural thing in the world—are you sure that’s okay?”
“…Are you telling me to run away from someone with Skills like that? No matter where I run, he’ll chase me to the ends of the earth.”
Father let out a sigh that sounded almost like resignation.
“But it’s a fact that that woman is dead. Just thinking about what would happen if he found out… heh heh heh.”
Father let out a “kukuku” and wore an evil grin for a while. Big Sister-in-law placed her hand on her head with a slight sigh and looked rather dejected.
“By the way, Motoyasu.”
“What is it? Ask me anything you like.”
“Well then, I’ll ask… Why do you hold a grudge against that woman? Tell me the reason.”
“She killed my beloved Lady Filolial!”

Ah… Fleon-chan. My ignorance is what caused your death. That’s why, no matter how many times this loop repeats, I’ll send the Crimson Swine straight to hell. Just as I was thinking that, Father spoke up.
“Let me rephrase the question. What was it like the moment you realized you’d been deceived?”

The moment I realized I’d been deceived, you say? That was… right around the time I was desperately trying to believe in that guy until the very end. Even thinking about it now makes my blood boil. That’s right… the Crimson Swine was trying to curry favor with Ren.
“After deserting the Spirit Tortoise in the face of the enemy, he betrayed me—even though I was still trying to believe in him—and was trying to win Ren over!”
“Spirit Tortoise, huh. I’ll set aside for now why the Four Auspicious Beasts suddenly came up. Well, let’s just go with the idea that he’s a strong enemy. So?”
“He was feeding Ren all sorts of lies—true and false—and made it seem like I was the one at fault for everything!”
“I see… Serves you right.”
Father flashed an evil grin. Why is he laughing? Still, since Father seems to be having fun, I’m starting to feel cheerful too. I’ll try mimicking his laugh.
“HAHAHA!”
At that, Father made a face as if he’d swallowed a bitter pill.
“Tsk… That’s exactly the kind of trick that woman would pull. So that’s why she’s holding a grudge.”
“That’s right.”
Seriously, that Crimson Swine is a real menace. No matter how many times she shows up, I’ll turn her into a pile of ashes.
“Well, whatever. Let’s just do what we have to do for now.”
“Guh!”
“Come on, Filo-chan! Let’s go back to where the cart was and help with the reconstruction!”
And just like that, we spent about an hour helping with the reconstruction.
After retrieving the cart and helping with the reconstruction, Father spoke to me.
“So, Motoyasu, which country should we flee to? Somewhere it’s easy to go into hiding would be best.”
“That’s true—we don’t want to go to Siltvelt or Shieldfreeden, do we?”
“Ah.”
“In that case…”

Would Faubrey be a good choice? But Takt is there, isn’t he? Plus, this is a crucial time for Filo-tan. It’s not a good place to flee with you guys, just like when Sakura-chan got hurt. You never know where Takt’s pigs might be lurking. So, we need a place that’s easy to hide in and good for Big Sister, too.
“Then how about Zeltoble? It’s a country of mercenaries and merchants. It’s where your Older Sister will eventually come, and it’s relatively neutral.”
“Got it. But getting back to the point, what happens if I don’t take action in Melromarc?”

“Either way, I think the Queen—the true ruler of Melromarc—will eventually return, and Father’s false charges will be cleared. She’s a reasonable woman; she won’t get angry even if you take out the Crimson Swine.”
“Have you ever killed that woman during a loop?”
“Of course I have!　I’ve made a bloodbath of her in almost every world.”
When I admitted that honestly, Father smiled briefly before his expression turned slightly displeased. After a while, perhaps his thoughts had turned elsewhere, and he said,
“If even her own parents despise her, that woman is truly finished…”
That’s right. The Crimson Swine is a has-been. Well, there’s never been any demand for her anyway.

“Never mind. Let’s try to suppress my anger by imagining a future where, after that queen returns, she loses her power in a fit of rage upon learning she was killed by the hero who cherished her precious daughter.”
“That’s not exactly a pleasant thought…”
Not at all. After all, those who repeatedly commit heinous crimes are getting their just deserts. It’s only natural to feel a sense of catharsis.
“…Anyway, I’ll tell you why I thought you might actually be telling the truth.”
“Haha! And what might that be?”
I knelt on the ground, rubbing my head against the earth as I listened to Father speak. Then, in a somewhat reluctant tone, he told me:
“It’s because you called that Trash king ‘Trash.’ I’m sure I was thinking it to myself, but since you knew, it gave me a little time to reflect.”
Oh! That’s unexpected information. But why the annoyed tone, I wonder?
“Is this really okay? I mean… things are changing so rapidly right now?”
“I understand how you feel, but as things stand, we can’t stay in this country. Above all, even if Motoyasu were to come out and say it was all a lie, we’d end up being hunted down.”
“…I suppose so.”
My older sister nodded as if she’d given up. Don’t worry. I won’t run or hide.
“Guh?”
Ah, Filo-chan. With such an innocent gaze, this Motoyasu is so happy I feel like I might just burst.
“Well then, let’s go! Portal Spear!”
And so, we teleported to Zeltoble.
“Oh… the scenery sure has changed quite a bit.”

After we arrived, Father squinted intently and muttered this as we stood in front of the facilities associated with the Filolial Racecourse in Zeltoble’s capital. This is a place full of memories for me. Back in the Loop era, Yuki-chan competed in tournaments here, and in the peaceful world, the Filolial Queen & King Cup was held here—it’s a place that brings back fond memories.
“Gua?”

Filo-tan looks a bit confused, tilting her head as she surveys the surroundings. I’m sure Filo-tan will like it, too. After all, this place is packed with Filolial dreams. Mainly in terms of racing, though.
“So this is the capital of Zeltoble… Is that over there the market?”
Since it’s a town she’s never been to before, she asks, looking a bit hesitant.
“That’s the main street—it’s more of a street market than an actual market.”
“We have those in Melromarc, too. The actual market must be somewhere else… I can smell the sea.”
“Zeltoble is a country with a thriving shipping industry. That’s why the city was built right along the coast.”
“Huh…”
Father muttered this while glancing around. As a first-rate merchant and chef, there’s no way he wouldn’t be interested. After all, this is a place where business opportunities abound.
“That huge Colosseum… what’s that building that looks like an arena?”
“Just as you suspected, Father, that’s the main Colosseum. Since this is a nation of mercenaries, putting on battles is a lucrative business.”
I’ve heard there’s also a back Colosseum, too.
“The main one, huh. The public order seems a bit rough, but it’s certainly the perfect country to hide out in.”
Money, fame, status… it’s a country where you can achieve all of that through your own strength alone. With such a diverse mix of people, it’s also the perfect place to hide.
“Is it really safe?”
“Well… you’ve got to make some compromises somewhere to even get started. Whether you believe it or not, Motoyasu will explain everything in detail. It won’t hurt to just listen.”
If you say so, I’ll explain as much as you like. I’m quite the communicator, so I think I’d be well-suited for a job as a tour guide.
“So, Father, what should we do from here?”
“Either way, we’ll need money to go into hiding in this country. It also depends on how well we can maneuver before the Melromarc lot track us down, doesn’t it?”
Oh, as expected of you, Father. It seems you’ve already figured out the appropriate course of action with just this much information.
“For that, we’ll need at least a minimum level of strength, too…”
“Please let me handle strengthening Big Sister and little Filo.”
“There’s no way I’m leaving Raphtalia or Filo in your care. It’d be a disaster if they were just whisked away somewhere.”
Oh? You’re quite the suspicious one, Father. We’re in this together now, after all.

“In that case, since you and Father are both Heroes, we won’t gain any EXP by staying together—but wouldn’t it be a good idea to level up Big Sister and Filo-tan and improve their stats? You should come hunting with me, Motoyasu.”
